world: Harrowmere, a drowned canal city. Every lock has a keeper and every keeper answers to the Toll Magistrate, who taxes anything that floats or sells. The old river's spirits still take bargains from people foolish enough to ask: they give what is asked and keep something back. Guild cooks hold every licensed pitch; unlicensed stalls get tipped into the canal. Low magic, wet stone, lantern light, eel smoke.
who: Wren, a broke noodle cook in her twenties with a handcart, a quick tongue and no skill at fighting. She left the Guild kitchens after a row with her old master, Chef Odalric.
premise: I want to open my own noodle stand at the foot of the Tide Tower, where the lock crews eat.
